notes: Stories refined to ensure full coverage across schema/contracts, core logic, API alignment, bootstrap/integration, and testing with consistent ARCH-001 evidence.

change_log.value: Expanded to explicitly include interface schemas, DTO contracts, and dependency direction rules across all layers
Clarified statelessness, service isolation, and alignment to 9-service architecture defined in ARCH-001
Expanded to include dependency injection patterns, lifecycle management, and enforcement of no cross-layer violations

MAINT-ARCH-S1.title: Define Service Boundaries and Contracts
MAINT-ARCH-S1.description: Define explicit service interfaces, DTO schemas, and module boundaries for the 4-layer modular monolith (facades, domain services, infrastructure, adapters), including strict dependency direction rules and contract enforcement per ARCH-001.

MAINT-ARCH-S2.title: Refactor Domain Logic into Isolated Services
MAINT-ARCH-S2.description: Extract and reorganize existing domain logic into stateless, isolated service modules aligned to the 9-service architecture defined in ARCH-001, ensuring no cross-service leakage or shared mutable state.

MAINT-ARCH-S3.title: Align Facades and API Layer to Service Contracts
MAINT-ARCH-S3.description: Refactor FastAPI entrypoints and application facades to consume defined service interfaces strictly via contracts, removing direct domain coupling and enforcing adapter-based interaction patterns.

MAINT-ARCH-S4.title: Refactor Unit and Integration Test Coverage
MAINT-ARCH-S4.description: Update and expand unit and integration tests to validate service isolation, contract adherence, and facade-to-service interactions, ensuring no regression from pre-refactor baseline.

MAINT-ARCH-S5.title: Rewire Application Bootstrap and Service Registration
MAINT-ARCH-S5.description: Update application bootstrap (main.py) to register services via dependency injection, enforce clean lifecycle management, and guarantee no circular or cross-layer violations in accordance with modular monolith constraints.
